journeys.title: Product Lifecycle & Licensing
journeys.authority: PR80 unified register LIC-001–008
journeys.mapping: Eight bounded design statements mapped below; exact 28 gates and LIC-029–050 wording unresolved.

etl.requirement: Workflow → Job; no independent Task configuration
etl.gap: Optional legacy workflow_id and workflow CRUD exist. Real request write hook rejects both new models (CF-01). Preserve unassigned legacy jobs; do not invent workflow grouping.

etl.requirement: Workflow owns monitoring calendar, windows, frequency, duration and SLA
etl.gap: Timezone/weekdays/window/duration/SLA create/update contracts exist; full occurrence evaluation and workflow policy are not established. Expectation configuration never schedules external work.

etl.requirement: Job owns expected duration and optional long-running threshold, not workflow timing
etl.gap: WorkflowJob contracts exclude timing/SLA, but legacy JobOrderCreate still requires SLA and permits windows. No destructive removal of historical fields; define compatibility bridge and threshold semantics.

etl.requirement: Workflow dependency DAG and violation evidence
etl.gap: Same-workflow/self/cycle checks exist in create handler. Runtime violations missing; concurrent opposite-edge transactions may evade pre-commit graph check (inspection risk, not executed race).

etl.requirement: Native execution identity, logical executions and attempts
etl.gap: Reuse existing JobOrderHistory/PentahoAttempt/revisions; new workflow execution projection must join verified native identities, never names/times alone. Source row keys/epochs require fixtures.

etl.requirement: Read-only Oracle/MSSQL or approved logs; retain eligible Pentaho methods
etl.gap: DATABASE validation permits mssql/sqlserver; Oracle not implemented in this validation path. Need sanitized schema, authenticated read-only fixture and exact-build certification; no S3/SFTP in new ETL setup.

etl.requirement: Same-row RUNNING → terminal updates; overlapping scans/checkpoints
etl.gap: Acceptance/checkpoint/fence code exists; this does not prove a mutable source row is revisited after watermark advancement. Exercise updates with stable IDs, delays, restart, retention and duplicates.

etl.requirement: Long-running event uses actual elapsed time and fresh evidence
etl.gap: Expected duration/latest history exist; evaluator must distinguish absent heartbeat, running elapsed, terminal duration and clock uncertainty. Do not infer freshness from current UI refresh.

etl.requirement: ETL event rules distinct from alert rules
etl.gap: Generic normalized-event and condition facilities exist, but complete independently versioned ETL v1.7 event-to-alert contract is not demonstrated. Reuse engine; do not make parallel canonical identities.

etl.requirement: Monitoring Template → Workflow → Job effective policy
etl.gap: Generic activation/templates exist; workflow override provenance and reproducible inherited ETL policy resolution are missing from current routes. Confirm unspecified override/clear semantics before implementing.
Execution vocabulary exists. Complete named v1.7 event catalog/threshold decision text has not been recovered; do not fabricate additional events or severity defaults.
OPEN/RESOLVED alert states cannot alone demonstrate four-state ETL condition lifecycle. Keep outcome, monitoring health, completeness and schedule compliance separate.

etl.requirement: Idempotent event notification/correlation; channel authority unresolved
etl.gap: Existing outbox/history dedup reused. PR80 ETL row names PagerDuty/ServiceNow, but current transport rejects retired channels. No reintroduction until explicit authority resolves CF-04.

etl.requirement: Durable atomic acceptance, replay and loss accounting
etl.gap: Separate backend evidence/checkpoint atomicity from upstream collector queue loss. CHK-001 FAIL; CHK-002 BLOCKED. Independent admitted-ID/receipt accounting remains mandatory.
Clear filters fix present and two source-level checks pass; workflow editor absent. Existing latest-history monitoring projection does not implement full workflow health.

etl.requirement: Tenant isolation, RBAC, audit; monitoring only
etl.gap: Route permission mocks pass; new models absent from shared _PATHS, writes fail. Dependency has no direct org or workflow relationship for _resolve_org. Actual authenticated PostgreSQL path unverified.

licensing.existing: No entitlement model/API/UI located in backend/app or frontend/src; do not confuse dependency license audit with product licensing.
licensing.gap: Edition definitions and versioned entitlement schema

licensing.requirement: Signed entitlement bound to deployment identity
licensing.existing: Worker authentication and release attestation are not license signature validation.
licensing.gap: Issuer/key lifecycle, algorithm and deployment binding contract
Trusted clock, expiry, replay, renewal/offline policy

licensing.existing: No licensing grace enforcement located; historical evidence must remain accessible.
licensing.gap: Exact grace thresholds and non-destructive restrictions

licensing.existing: Existing scripts/uat/verify_publish.py and DEV05 evidence provide only adjacent release mechanisms.
scripts/uat/pull_release.py plus CHK-002 evidence; no product license-aware upgrade contract.

licensing.gap: End-to-end licensed deployment onboarding and owner UAT

licensing.existing: backend/app/security/scope.py; backend/tests/test_sprint08_rbac.py are shared foundations, not licensed-action tests.
licensing.gap: Specific licensing permissions, audit events and tenant enforcement tests
